title: Replicable Dueling Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2610.20908v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dueling bandits choose each comparison based on earlier noisy outcomes, so two runs on the same preferences can compare different pairs. We study replicable dueling bandits, where two executions with shared internal randomness and independent comparison outcomes must select the same ordered pair in every round with probability at least $1-\rho$. Building on Beat-the-Mean, whose scores change as arms are eliminated and need not rank the best arm highest, we design the first such algorithms with sublinear regret. Under relaxed stochastic transitivity with parameter $\gamma\ge 1$ and the stochastic triangle inequality, we design an algorithm that achieves expected regret $\widetilde{O}(\gamma^8 K^4 H_{\mathrm{p}}/\rho^2)$, where $H_{\mathrm{p}}=\sum_{i=2}^{K}(P_{1i}-1/2)^{-1}$. translated_abstract: 决斗老虎机根据早期的噪声反馈结果来选择每一次比较，因此在相同偏好下运行两次，可能会比较不同的臂对。我们研究可复制的对决老虎机问题：两次执行共享内部随机性且比较结果相互独立，并要求以至少 $1-\rho$ 的概率在每一轮选择相同的有序臂对。在 Beat-the-Mean 算法的基础上——该算法的得分会随臂被淘汰而变化，且不一定将最优臂排在最高——我们设计了首批具有次线性遗憾的此类算法。在参数 $\gamma\ge 1$ 的松弛随机传递性以及随机三角不等式条件下，我们设计了一种算法，其期望遗憾为 $\widetilde{O}(\gamma^8 K^4 H_{\mathrm{p}}/\rho^2)$，其中 $H_{\mathrm{p}}=\sum_{i=2}^{K}(P_{1i}-1/2)^{-1}$。在强随机传递性条件下，我们设计了一种基于同时淘汰的算法，改善了对臂数 $K$ 的依赖性，并实现了 $\widetilde{O}(K^2\cdots)$ 的遗憾界。
tldr: 该论文首次为可复制的对决老虎机设计了具有次线性遗憾的算法，在松弛随机传递性下实现 $\widetilde{O}(\gamma^8 K^4 H_p/\rho^2)$ 的期望遗憾，并在强随机传递性下通过同时淘汰策略改善了对臂数 $K$ 的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first replicable dueling bandit algorithms with sublinear regret, achieving $\widetilde{O}(\gamma^8 K^4 H_p/\rho^2)$ expected regret under relaxed stochastic transitivity and improving the dependence on the number of arms $K$ under strong stochastic transitivity via simultaneous elimination.
